findings.title: AI agent job has write permissions
findings.evidence: AI-related job can write repository resources.
findings.risk: Compromised model instructions can alter code, releases, or deployments.
findings.recommendation: Split analysis into a read-only job; gate writes behind a reviewed, narrowly-scoped job.

findings.title: Untrusted event text reaches an AI agent
findings.risk: An attacker can steer an agent through issue, PR, or comment content.
findings.recommendation: Treat event text as untrusted data, delimit it, validate instructions, and isolate the agent in a read-only job.
findings.patch_preview: # Pass untrusted content through a validated data file; keep the agent job read-only.

findings.title: Secrets exposed to agent consuming untrusted input
findings.evidence: The same AI job receives secrets and attacker-controlled text.
findings.risk: Prompt injection may cause credential disclosure or misuse.
findings.recommendation: Remove secrets from the analysis job; use short-lived, scoped credentials only after approval.
findings.patch_preview: # Remove secrets from the untrusted-input job and pass only approved outputs forward.

findings.title: AI output is executed as shell
findings.evidence: Agent output is written to or evaluated by a shell.
findings.risk: Prompt injection can become arbitrary code execution.
findings.recommendation: Never execute model output. Use a strict typed allowlist and require human approval for privileged operations.
findings.patch_preview:
- bash commands.sh
+ python validate_plan.py commands.json
+ # require_environment_approval

findings.title: Sensitive configuration file committed
findings.risk: Credentials may be exposed through source history and artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Remove the file from tracking, rotate every contained credential, purge history when necessary, and add an ignore rule.

findings.title: OpenAI API key detected
findings.risk: A usable credential may be exposed to anyone with repository access.
findings.recommendation: Revoke or rotate the credential immediately, remove it from history, and use GitHub encrypted secrets.

findings.title: Database URL with password detected
findings.risk: A usable credential may be exposed to anyone with repository access.
findings.recommendation: Revoke or rotate the credential immediately, remove it from history, and use GitHub encrypted secrets.

findings.title: Comment-triggered privileged action lacks trust check
findings.evidence: Comment command is accepted without author_association validation.
findings.risk: Any commenter may trigger a sensitive workflow.
findings.recommendation: Require OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR association and use environment approval.

findings.title: Artifact uploads the whole repository
findings.risk: Secrets, source, and local configuration may be published as an artifact.
findings.recommendation: Upload an explicit allowlist of build outputs and exclude secret-bearing extensions.

findings.title: Artifact retention is too long
findings.risk: Sensitive data remains downloadable longer than necessary.
findings.recommendation: Reduce retention to 7 days or the minimum required.

findings.title: Missing .github/dependabot.yml
findings.risk: Repository governance and maintenance controls are incomplete.

findings.title: Missing .gitignore
findings.risk: Sensitive local files may be committed.
findings.recommendation: Create .gitignore with environment and key patterns.

findings.title: Missing .gitignore
findings.risk: Repository governance and maintenance controls are incomplete.

findings.title: Missing CODEOWNERS
findings.risk: Repository governance and maintenance controls are incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS using the provided template.

findings.title: Missing LICENSE
findings.risk: Repository governance and maintenance controls are incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Add LICENSE using the provided template.

findings.title: Missing SECURITY.md
findings.risk: Repository governance and maintenance controls are incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Add SECURITY.md using the provided template.

findings.title: zizmor unavailable or failed
findings.risk: Coverage from this optional scanner is unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Install/configure zizmor; other audits completed normally.
